title: Ants Build Underground Cities Without a Plan | Engineering
description: Discover the incredible secret behind how ants construct massive underground cities. It's not about blueprints, but simple rules that create engineering marvels! Learn the hidden mechanism.
instagram_caption: Ever wondered how ants create their complex underground cities? It's all about tiny actions leading to massive structures! Follow for more incredible nature insights.

segments.narration: This tiny insect builds entire cities with no blueprint. How is it possible?
Ants don't plan. Each follows simple rules based on its immediate surroundings.
When an ant finds loose soil, it simply digs it up. That's its first rule.
It then carries this tiny soil grain away, dropping it elsewhere near the nest.
broll_queries: ant carrying dirt particle close up

segments.narration: Thousands of ants doing this create piles, which guide where to dig next.
broll_queries: ant colony entrance dirt mound close up

segments.narration: They naturally avoid areas where others just dropped soil, creating empty spaces.
broll_queries: ants in tunnel movement close up

segments.narration: This simple collective behavior forms intricate tunnels that branch deep underground.
Large chambers emerge for nurseries, food, and even special fungal gardens.
Many chambers even include dedicated ventilation shafts, keeping the city's air fresh.
Some ant cities span areas the size of a tennis court, twenty feet deep.
